Name: Dynamic Glass Doors for PIF Windows and Plants
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

I created these glass doors because I wanted them both glass and narrow because they take up less space on the wall, for my PIF greenhouses and for an outdoor PIF mod that is coming soon and that I am still testing and now I am sharing them with everyone!.

This mod adds to the game more dynamic glass PIF [color=#00ffff]doors[/color] that change at night or with the rain they can also be used as decorative doors if you don't have PIF mods,  six dynamic [color=#00ffff]windows[/color], three decorative [color=#00ffff]plants[/color], several [color=#00ffff]curtains[/color] of various colors and two Persian [color=#00ffff]carpets[/color]. to decorate the farmer's house, you can buy them all in Robin's shop.
Added six dynamic windows, one wide and two narrow tall and three short windows of different shapes.
Added several curtains of various colors and two Persian rugs.

These glass doors pair well with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28346]Enchanted Garden (PIF)[/url] or my greenhouses: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26936]Large Greenhouse (PIF)[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22543]Secret Greenhouse (PIF)[/url]

Languages: English and Italian, translatable into other languages, feel free to translate via i18n and post your translation here on Nexus linking to this
mod.
Added Spanish translation, made by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/messenger/5767498/#][b]Hayato2236[/b][/url]

Instructions for those who want to translate:
When you translate an i18n file you must post only the file you translated, zipper it with a zipper program and post it here on Nexus linking my mod as a dependency.

Installation:
Extract and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.
When you update the mod you have to delete the old and install the new.

Enjoy! <3

[s]I also intend to create windows like these doors and will add them to the mod later. [/s] [color=#00ffff]Done![/color][s]
[/s]
Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
